address: 350 rue de Castelnau Est, Montréal, H2R 1P9, Canada
bio: A brand-new bistro in a lively, buzzing neighborhood. Chef Charles-Tristan Prévost, previously at the renowned Le Club Chasse et Pêche, cooks up generous, meticulously prepared and indulgent bistro cuisine. He sources produce from the famous Jean Talon market nearby. The already iconic Casavant sausage and mash is a mainstay on the menu, as is the confit leek tartlet with Mornay goat's cheese and hazelnut sauce. The evening menu expands to include beef tartare and smoked mackerel, sea bass à la grenobloise, and magret de canard with cider sauce. Natural wines are well represented on the wine list. Cordial, laid-back service adds to the charm of the place....
